questiontext.text: Which of the following are recognized forms of Examination Malpractice? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Smuggled notes, mercenaries, smartphones, and chalkboard collusion are fraudulent vices. Solving past questions at home is legitimate study.

questiontext.text: Which of the following are destructive consequences of Examination Malpractice? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Devalued certificates, expulsion, innocent casualties, and criminal prosecution are verified consequences. Cheating destroys real knowledge.
